ENCOUNTER & CLINICAL REVIEW
Visit ID: VIS-002 | Visit Type: Post-Operative Follow-Up
Post-operative surgical oncology follow-up consultation. Patient seen in clinic approximately 2.5 weeks following right partial mastectomy
and sentinel lymph node dissection.
WOUND & PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Surgical Site: Right breast incision clean, dry, and intact with mild healing erythema. No seroma or hematoma. Right axillary incision is
healing appropriately without tenderness.
Systemic Review: Pain adequately managed with oral non-opioid analgesics. No fever or chills reported.
MEDICATION VERIFICATION
Active Medication: Tamoxifen 20 mg oral daily continued as prescribed on 2026-01-15.
